destination.description: S3 Table Bucket ARN (arn:aws:s3tables:...) or S3 path (bucket/path without s3:// prefix) for Glue catalog.

namespace.description: Iceberg namespace. Auto-determined by schema if omitted.

batch_size.description: Number of GFF3 records per processing batch (default: 100000)

gff3_file.description: S3 URI to the input GFF3 file (.gff3 or .gff3.gz)
